correctness.rationale: The Weyl expansion identifies rank with nonzero ambiguity coefficients for each (a,b). Rationality and minimal-polynomial divisibility of Φ_{p^j} establish the exact digital-fiber equalities for all p^k and every shift, including zero-frequency positivity. For odd n, exponents x+((x-a) mod n) are distinct, and uniqueness of binary expansion proves all overlap shifts have full frequency support under taper. The cyclic digit-cross difference-cover and overlap counts classify every shift, yielding flat rank p^4-(p-1)(p²-p+2) and taper rank p^4. Executed checker validates sampled finite cases, exact flat-cross histograms p=3,5,7,11, and an independently constructed 81-projector numerical Gram rank for p=3. The proof, not those finite tests, handles unbounded primes.

originality.rationale: A finite-prime rational-window rigidity result counts rank only on Z/p; the verified prime-square layers are not its parameter substitution because primitive p-squared and order-p frequencies can vanish separately. General Weyl diagonalization is known, whereas no inspected primary result supplies these explicit rational prime-power digit-fiber criteria and the cyclic digit-cross nullity with its support-preserving full-rank taper. The Cartesian product-group cross in the accessible ledger is structurally different and produces a different nullity. Residual risk is that a broader cyclotomic treatment elsewhere implicitly implies the specialization.
residual_risks: Full historical priority cannot be certified by bounded literature/database search; an unindexed paper could formulate the same p² specialization.
General Weyl diagonalization and cyclotomic divisibility are classical and not independently novel.
Numerical/finite exact checks are not a substitute for the general proof.

value.rationale: The natural base-p digit cross is an explicit near-counting-bound O(sqrt(n))-size difference cover on cyclic Z/p². Its unexpected flat-weight rank loss (p-1)(p²-p+2), despite all translation differences present, is an arithmetic measurement obstruction; explicit positive integer reweighting yields full matrix tomography without expanding support. The valuation-layer rank formula diagnoses exactly which cyclotomic harmonic orders are lost for all rational nonnegative p-power windows. The result distinguishes support geometry from coefficient interference and provides a precise family of nullities and an actionable deterministic sparse construction, without implying stability or minimum sparsity.
